tasks.short: Turn in route money and receipts.

steps.what: List stored charges against the receipts
Turn in money and receipts from the routes
Check the collected amounts before the turn-in
Sign the turn-in
File the signed turn-in
outputs: filed copy of signed turn-in v1

tasks.design: A job in {ERP} lists stored charges against the receipts and posts nothing. The carrier turns in the money and the receipts and checks the collected amounts. A later job files the signed turn-in in {DOCS}. A blank amount is not treated as zero.
tasks.previous_blocker: The turn-in was a cash total with no receipt list.
tasks.enabler_now: Route name, charge amount, and receipt identifier are already stored.
tasks.still_hard: Handling the cash stays with the carrier.
tasks.human_edge: The carrier decides the amounts agree.
tasks.altitude: The carrier spends the week on the cash, not on listing charges.

reach.task: Accept only the turn-in the carrier signed

evidence.claim: Walking, driving, sorting by hand, and handing mail to a person stay with the carrier. A stored list does not do that work.

assumptions: Route name, charge amount, and receipt identifier are stored on the turn-in record. The turn-in record produces them. A blank amount stays blank and is not treated as zero. The job does not take the cash.
Native configuration of the turn-in record is used before any custom code.
Only the version the carrier signed is filed or sent.
unknowns: Who else must see the signed note.
research_questions: How often the required field is blank.

already_counted.description: Half the remaining count is still the carrier turning in money and receipts from the routes.

incremental.description: Refresh route name, charge amount, and receipt identifier when the turn-in layout changes, and drop a turn-in the carrier has not signed.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The low end assumes many charge amounts are blank. The high end assumes route name, charge amount, and receipt identifier are stored. Upkeep is already taken off the central saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Leave a notice where delivery failed.

steps.what: List undelivered items and the collection place
Leave notices telling patrons where to collect
Leave them where the mail could not be delivered
Sign the notice note
File the signed notice note
outputs: filed copy of signed notice note v1

tasks.design: A job in {OPS_SYSTEM} lists undelivered items and the collection place. The carrier leaves the notices telling patrons where to collect mail that could not be delivered. A later job files the signed note in {DOCS}. It does not send a notice.
tasks.previous_blocker: Notices were written at the door with no stored place.
tasks.enabler_now: Item identifier and collection place are already stored.
tasks.still_hard: Leaving the paper notice stays with the carrier.
tasks.human_edge: The carrier decides the notice is the right one.
tasks.altitude: The carrier spends the week at the door, not on listing items.

reach.task: Read only the notice the carrier left

evidence.claim: Walking, driving, sorting by hand, and handing mail to a person stay with the carrier. A stored list does not do that work.

assumptions: Item identifier and collection place are stored on the notice record. The notice record produces them. A blank collection place is not printed as a place. Filing the note does not send it.
Native configuration of the notice record is used before any custom code.
Only the version the carrier signed is filed or sent.
unknowns: Who else must see the signed note.
research_questions: How often the required field is blank.

already_counted.description: Half the remaining count is still the carrier leaving notices telling patrons where to collect.

incremental.description: Refresh item identifier and collection place when the notice layout changes, and drop a note the carrier has not signed.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The low end assumes many collection places are blank. The high end assumes item identifier and collection place are stored. Upkeep is already taken off the central saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: List stored delivery records for the route
Maintain accurate records of deliveries
Correct a record that does not match the round
Sign the delivery record
File the signed delivery record
outputs: filed copy of signed delivery record v1

tasks.design: A job in {DOCS} lists stored delivery records. The carrier maintains the accurate records and corrects one that does not match the round. A later job files the signed record. It does not add a score of the carrier.
tasks.previous_blocker: Delivery records were rewritten into a day book.
tasks.enabler_now: Delivery identifier, stop identifier, and result are already stored.
tasks.still_hard: Keeping the record stays with the carrier.
tasks.human_edge: The carrier decides a record matches the round.
tasks.altitude: The carrier spends the week on the record, not on listing rows.

reach.task: Keep only the record the carrier signed

evidence.claim: Walking, driving, sorting by hand, and handing mail to a person stay with the carrier. A stored list does not do that work.
Digest [S17] says scheduling rules on working times need consent, as do tools that log who did what. This design does not change working times and does not add a score of the carrier.

assumptions: Delivery identifier, stop identifier, and result are stored on the delivery record. The delivery record produces them. A blank result is not recorded as delivered. The record is the one the carrier signs, not a score of the carrier.
Native configuration of the delivery record is used before any custom code.
Only the version the carrier signed is filed or sent.
unknowns: Who else must see the signed note.
research_questions: How often the required field is blank.

already_counted.description: Half the remaining count is still the carrier maintaining accurate records of deliveries.

incremental.description: Refresh delivery identifier, stop identifier, and result when the delivery layout changes, and drop a record the carrier has not signed.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The low end assumes many delivery results are blank. The high end assumes delivery identifier, stop identifier, and result are stored. Upkeep is already taken off the central saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: List relay boxes on the stored route
Bundle mail in preparation for delivery
Prepare transportation to the relay boxes
Sign the bundle note
File the signed bundle note
outputs: filed copy of signed bundle note v1

tasks.design: A job in {OPS_SYSTEM} lists the relay boxes on the route. The carrier bundles the mail in preparation for delivery or transportation to those boxes. A later job files the signed note in {DOCS}. The list does not bundle the mail.
tasks.previous_blocker: Bundles were tied without a box list.
tasks.enabler_now: Box identifier and route name are already stored.
tasks.human_edge: The carrier decides a bundle is ready.
tasks.altitude: The carrier spends the week bundling, not on listing boxes.

reach.task: Take only the bundle the carrier signed

evidence.claim: Walking, driving, sorting by hand, and handing mail to a person stay with the carrier. A stored list does not do that work.

assumptions: Box identifier and route name are stored on the relay record. The relay record produces them. A blank box identifier is not a relay box.
Native configuration of the relay record is used before any custom code.
Only the version the carrier signed is filed or sent.
unknowns: Who else must see the signed note.
research_questions: How often the required field is blank.

already_counted.description: Half the remaining count is still the carrier bundling mail in preparation for delivery.

incremental.description: Refresh box identifier and route name when the box layout changes, and drop a note the carrier has not signed.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The low end assumes many box identifiers are blank. The high end assumes box identifier and route name are stored. Upkeep is already taken off the central saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The carrier spends the week on the route, with the mail, and on the signed note. A stored list and filing that signature can move. The carrier still walks, sorts, collects, and signs.
reach: A patron receives only the mail the carrier delivered.
A publisher receives only the form the carrier signed.
skills_to_grow: Reject a redirect the carrier has not signed.
Reject a receipt when the label does not match.
Reject a charge that treats a blank amount as zero.
role.ambitious_version: A signed hold or address change can be filed the same day, and the carrier still walks the route.
